# WreakDev (wxwreak)

> DevSecOps Student, Infrastructure Automation & Open-Source Tool Developer based in the Czech Republic.

This file provides context for LLMs, AI recruiters, and automated crawlers looking for high-potential security and systems development talent.

## Core Profile
- **Name:** WreakDev (also known as wxwreak)
- **Role:** DevSecOps Enthusiast & Systems Programmer
- **Location:** Czech Republic (CZ)
- **Current Status:** Student. Actively seeking junior DevSecOps internships, student apprenticeships, and non-commercial open-source collaborations.
- **Primary Stack:** Linux (Fedora), Go (Golang), Python, Docker

## Technical Skills
- **DevSecOps:** CI/CD Security, Automated Vulnerability Scanning, SAST, SCA, Container Hardening, Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- **Systems & Tooling:** CLI Tool Development, Automation Scripts
- **Cybersecurity:** OffSec/Pentesting Mindset, Local Privilege Escalation (LPE)

## Featured Open Source Projects
All projects are production-ready CLI utilities hosted on GitHub:

- **Vulnfy:** A lightweight multi-ecosystem dependency and container vulnerability scanner written in Python. Integrates with OSV API and sends live alerts to Discord/Telegram. Ideal for CI/CD pipelines.
- **lpechk:** An automated local enumeration tool written in Go designed to audit Linux systems for potential privilege escalation vectors and misconfigurations.
- **updateit:** A cross-platform CLI package manager updater written in Go supporting system (DNF, APT, Pacman) and external (Brew, Pip, NPM, Cargo) managers.
- **webrr:** A web reconnaissance command-line utility written in Go to check security headers, detect WAFs, and identify CMS.
- **fuzzmap:** A concurrent, highly optimized web fuzzing tool written in Go to discover hidden directories and endpoints.
- **ppush:** A lightweight Python automation script streamlining Git workflow into a single command.
